_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Mo ye Player {player_id}, ye na lînga {num_rounds} ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Mo âra ${pool} pou spliti lînga sô na Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Fâ ofri: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Sô a ye akcepti → Mo ye $(pool - X), Player ôko a ye $X
  - Sô a ye refusi → Bala ôko a ye $0
  - Exemple: [Offer: $3]  ou  'Mo kiri sô ye justi. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Décidi sô na ofri na [Accept] ou [Reject]
  - Exemple: 'Sô ye raisonnable. [Accept]'
            'Sô ye déraisonnable. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Tondi {round_number} asali! ---
Mokonzi {proposer_id} aye mokonzi môko, Mokonzi {responder_id} aye mokonzi môko ôko.
round.offer: Tondi {round_number}: Mokonzi {proposer_id} abêsi mbongo ${offer} na Mokonzi {responder_id} (akpêsi mbongo ${keep}).
round.accepted: Mokonzi {responder_id} atêri! Tondi {round_number} azênga: Mokonzi {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mokonzi {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Bilansi yé: Mokonzi 0: ${total_0}, Mokonzi 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} a refusi ofri! Lînga {round_number} a ye bala ôko: Bala ôko a ye +$0. Totals a resti: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: A lingbi zo so amû tënë ni asara kua na kode ti fango mbeti [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: A lingbi wungo ti nginza so a mû na mo aduti mbeni ye so ayeke tâ nzoni.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Mbeni ye ti kiri tënë na ni ayeke dä pëpe.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder ti kɛ̈ kɔc [Accept] thiɛ̈k [Reject] alɔɔk.

outcome.win: Mokonzi {winner} aye mokonzi môko na mbongo ${winner_total} vs Mokonzi {loser} môko na mbongo ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: A-joueur use kue awara ${total} na nda ni.
